_comment: matcher is a REGEX over the TOOL NAME (e.g. 'Bash', 'Write|Edit'), not the
permissions grammar. This previously read 'Bash(*)', which is the wrong
syntax AND an invalid regex, so the hook never fired at all.
One entry covers every tool the hook script dispatches on — keep the two in
timeout is omitted so Claude Code's own default applies; the value here was
previously 5000 on the assumption of milliseconds.
